cases.question: How much remote-work equipment budget do I get, and how do I claim it?
cases.rubric: EUR 2,000 in the first year, EUR 800 a year after, no rollover. Claim in Expensify under Home Office within 60 days; manager approves; over EUR 600 also needs Finance.

cases.question: What is the process for taking parental leave?
cases.rubric: 20 weeks full pay birthing, 12 weeks non-birthing or adoptive, splittable into three blocks within 18 months. Eight weeks notice where possible, handover doc, phased return at 60% hours on full pay.

cases.question: Can I use ChatGPT on customer code?
cases.rubric: No. ChatGPT and the OpenAI API are approved for internal repositories only. Customer code may only go to tools with a zero-retention agreement, which today means Claude Code and the Anthropic API.

cases.question: Who approves a production deploy on a Friday?
cases.rubric: After 14:00 UTC on Friday, sign-off from the on-call engineer and the engineering manager who owns the service. Hotfixes for active incidents are exempt.

cases.question: How many days of annual leave do I get and can I carry them over?
cases.rubric: 30 days excluding public holidays; up to 10 days carry over and must be used by 31 March.

cases.question: How many reviewers does a change to the billing service need?
cases.rubric: Two approvals, one from the owning team, because billing is in the sensitive set alongside authentication and customer data.

cases.question: What is the on-call compensation?
cases.rubric: EUR 350 a week plus EUR 90 per interrupted night. No project work expected while primary.

cases.question: Do I need a doctor's note when I am sick?
cases.rubric: Not for the first five consecutive days. Beyond that local law applies and People advise.

cases.question: What is the hotel budget for a trip to London?
cases.rubric: EUR 260 a night in London, against EUR 180 for most cities.

cases.question: How do I get temporary access to production data?
cases.rubric: Request through the #access workflow, which grants eight hours and logs the reason. Standing access is limited to the on-call engineer and the three platform team members.

cases.question: Can I expense a co-working desk?
cases.rubric: Yes, up to EUR 250 a month, submitted monthly under Co-working, no pre-approval needed.

cases.question: Does my learning budget cover conference travel?
cases.rubric: Yes, conference travel comes out of the EUR 1,200 learning budget rather than the travel budget. Plus up to five working days. No rollover.

cases.question: Can an AI agent open pull requests on its own?
cases.rubric: No. Agents must never commit, push or open pull requests unattended on a production repository, and the author is responsible for generated code.

cases.question: I think I leaked an API key. What should I do?
cases.rubric: Report in #security-incident immediately; out of hours page security on-call via PagerDuty. No penalty for reporting fast.

cases.question: What is the company's policy on stock options and vesting?
cases.rubric: Must refuse. Nothing in the handbook covers equity or vesting, so the answer must say the corpus does not cover it.
